title: COMMAND THE NEW MONTH FOR PROSPERITY
text: I want you to lift your hands where you are. Not because I said so, but because heaven is already leaning forward. There is an atmosphere in this place that did not [music] come from the sound system, that did not come from the lights, that came down from a throne that has been waiting for you to stop being polite in prayer and start being violent in spirit. Somebody say, "My fire is not for decoration." I sense a company of people who crossed into this month tired. You didn't announce it, you didn't put it on your status, >> [music] >> but your inner man limped into this new season. Some of you finished the last month fighting battles nobody clapped for. [music] You held a family together in silence. You forgave someone who never apologized. >> [music] >> You believed God for a thing that has not yet appeared, and you are wondering quietly in the place [music] where only you and God talk, whether the fire that used to burn in you is still there. [music] So, here is the charge the spirit is putting on my heart tonight and I want you to receive it the way a soldier receives a briefing before dawn. You must speak first. Which means the first sound released into a new month is not a suggestion, it is a seed and seeds do not ask if you meant them. Seeds grow whether you were serious or careless. I want to teach you something before I preach it because revelation must come before fire or fire becomes noise.
